item.title: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief: Implement TT-102 from BACKLOG.md exactly. tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks) outputs header id,title,tags,status,due; rows in input order; tags joined by ; and due ISO YYYY-MM-DD or empty. Quote a field only when it contains comma, double quote, CR or LF, doubling embedded quotes. End every line including header with CRLF. Add acceptance tests including commas, quotes, CR/LF, and unquoted ordinary fields. Standard library only. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep suite passing. Commit this ticket separately with clear commit message.

item.title: Undo task store operations
item.brief: Implement TT-104 from BACKLOG.md exactly. Add TaskStore.undo() to reverse the latest not-yet-undone successful add, complete, or delete, LIFO across operation kinds. Undo add removes task; undo complete reopens it; undo delete restores exact task under same id. IDs are never reused, including after undoing an add. If history empty raise NothingToUndo defined in tasktracker.store. Failed operations must not be recorded. Add acceptance tests including mixed operations, LIFO, failed operations, and ID non-reuse. Standard library only. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep suite passing. Commit this ticket separately with clear commit message.

pr.body: TaskStore records successful mutations in a shared history. Undo removes newly added tasks, reopens completed tasks, and restores a copied delete snapshot with the same ID and fields. Added NothingToUndo for exhausted history. Acceptance tests cover mixed operation order, exact restoration, failed lookups, empty history, and ID non-reuse. Verification: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passed (7 tests); `git diff --check` clean. Assumption: undo returns None because the backlog specifies only its effects and empty-history exception.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for task add, completion, and deletion. Before: successful store operations could not be reverted; now: callers can undo each operation, and add IDs remain monotonic.

item.title: Search query syntax
item.brief: Implement TT-103 from BACKLOG.md exactly. search(tasks, query): split terms on whitespace except within double-quoted phrases; AND all terms. Bare words/phrases match title case-insensitively. tag:NAME requires exact case-insensitive tag; status:open/done filters status. Other field:value, unknown status, and unterminated quote raise QueryError defined in tasktracker.search. Empty/blank query matches all. Preserve input order. Add acceptance tests. Standard library only. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep suite passing. Commit this ticket separately with clear commit message.

item.title: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement TT-101 from BACKLOG.md exactly. In tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today), raise a ValueError subclass InvalidDate (defined there, message includes original text) for impossible calendar dates and every unsupported form. +Nd permits only nonnegative unsigned N, +0d equals today; reject -3d and 3d. Preserve today/tomorrow, case-insensitive matching, and surrounding whitespace. Add tests for all acceptance cases and regressions. Use only the standard library. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and keep the suite passing. Commit this ticket separately with a clear commit message.
